text:
I was really in the mood to eat a grouper ruben and chill outside with a beer today. That didn't happen here. The service made it impossible to chill. It seemed hard to get table service and when someone did notice us she seemed annoyed. I thought about getting up and leaving but was afraid to cancel my order because the waitress was so rude. So instead I got a grouper ruben, but on a hamburger bun because they were out of rye bread AND out of French fires. Our waitress also had very little knowledge of any drinks (craft beer or wine). She seemed annoyed we were there, it made me uncomfortable. Also the live music was annoying. 
You are better off going to the Marriott or Stones Throw. Very nice ambience and good service for the same price.

Went here thinking it was a top of the line steakhouse, and it was not. It was very loud, and bright. Our server was preoccupied with another large party, so he did not take care with my husband my small party of 2. Food was ok, though the crab cakes were tiny for the price.
I decided to eat here, and It wasn't bad, however I just got French toast. Everything here was a little too eccentric.

Took 45 minutes just to get our appetizer. Although the food was good the service is lousy. Sat for 15 minutes and had to ask if we had a waiters. Then the waiter never asked us if we wanted anything to drink.  Also it's extremely noisy, couldn't hear my husband who was across from me over the noise.  In the future I'll only do take out

So pleased to have such a great new place open in northwest Reno. We had the crispy Brussels sprouts and bacon blue cheese burger. Everything was delicious-prepared beautifully. Good tap beer selection and service was awesome! Tucked into a little shopping center so a little hard to find but so worth the visit! We are big fans and will be regulars. Can't wait to sample more menu items.
Overall one of the nicer fuzzy locations.  However, St. Louis is struggling getting nice ones.  Out west all newer and way nicer. Food was fast

Food was well prepared and well served. The HUGE turnoff was the extra cologned, fabrize soaked waiter that took our breath away every time he passed our table. Managers should clue their staff in about this.
Puhleez! Felt like I was at a coin laundromat.
great outdoor ambiance and amazing grilled cheese  we split a very reasonably priced bottle of local rosé which was very yummy. dying to go back here for some beers!

Look no further during the week- this is your weekday morning breakfast spot once you try it once. The owner is exceptionally personable and can customise each entree if needed. 
The frittata are well seasoned and veggies well cooked. The omelette was also well seasoned. Didn't try the coffee but maybe on  one of my many return trips!!

Love the atmosphere. It's a favorite for any out of towners I bring there; they always want to go back. Lately I feel like the drinks are served in smaller cups and the portions have been smaller. They used to serve 3 tacos, but a few weeks ago my boyfriend only got 2 with his meal. The sweet potato fries have also been served in smaller baskets. Still would recommend.

There's no doubt I will come back here. The Parmesan crab fries may have been some of the best fries that I've ever had. The sauce that can on them were amazing as well. I can literally go back just for them. The Mahi Mahi sandwich was great as well. It was seasoned just right and the bread had a nice toast to it. 

Mark our server was quick and efficient. He had many tables but was able to get everyone taken care of. If you're in the Franklin area do yourself a favor and check this place out!
Great Breakfast and lunch at reasonable prices. Only had bad service once in the year I've been going there. It can get quite busy but they always keep up and get food out quick.
Absolutely love VIP, best margaritas, great food, fantastic service. It's small and you have to wait, but that's just part of the fun.

My wife & I wanted to go somewhere local, for dinner tonight, and hadn't been to Bertucci's in awhile.  I was just looking for a bowl of soup, and spaghetti & meatballs. Who would think, that would be a tough order for an Italian restaurant ?  To say it may very well have been the worst spaghetti & meatballs I've ever had, might just be an understatement. The meatballs were the size of ping pong balls & were so burnt & rubbery they could have probably bounced higher.  Again, when an Italian restaurant can't do a decent dish of spaghetti, it's probably time to lock the doors.
Really wanted some take out and Freddy's is what I decided, drove 25 minutes out to get an uncooked burger. Never again.

I love you guys. Great pie once again. Got the Margherita specialty pie for their Monday specialty pie special.  I added fresh tomatoes which made it a bit wet but I always fire up the small oven at home anyway to heat the slices so I knew this going in. 

Delivery was ahead of schedule. It decided to pour right then. Murphy's Law I guess for my delivery guy. He wasn't phased. It's that time of year for storms. 

All I've gotten from them is pies but I've been consistently happy. And when you find a good local pie place around you you're fortunate. Thanks!

Maybe I just lucked out, but I thought the food and service were excellent! I came for the views, but decided to grab a Hurricane burger and strawberry colada while I waited for the rooftop to open (12 noon). Everything was so tasty! Burger was seasoned and flavorful with a butter bun too (it's the little things!). Fries were crunchy, hot, and peppered. Drink was delicious and cheap..  $6.25 for a frozen "umbrella" drink?! Yes,please! Our server, Cindy, was so friendly and helpful.. she checked on us frequently and made sure we had everything we could possibly need. This is a beach bar that really exceeded expectations!

Party Fowl was our first Hot Chicken experience in Nashville and it did not disappoint. We came to enjoy some chicken, drinks and college hoops, and Party Fowl fit the bill perfectly.

The chicken was spicy and tender and came served on texas toast, which soaked up the spice and flavor of the chicken. Dill pickles and cole slaw rounded the meal out nicely.

We also placed an order for the bourbon glazed beignets, which unfortunately never arrived. When we checked on the status with our server, we learned that the fire had been turned off for the night (this was at the end of the night). That was a bit of a disappointment but an honest mistake, and our server discounted our bill and bought us another round of drinks on the house. So that cured our spirits. I sampled a few of Nashville's local beers and my friends had the watermelon frosé, to which they gave two thumbs up.

Overall, Party Fowl offers a casual vibe with good food and drinks for catching some sports (or just catching up) with friends.

Such an awesome find! Food is delicious, the people are so sweet here. They have a great set up and it's my new go to breakfast spot. Very fortunate to have this place in the area, there aren't many like it. Simple, unassuming, and great food.

I hesitate to review this place because it is so damn good I want it all to myself...Firstoff, if huge portions of mediocre fare that you can get just about anywhere else is what you're looking for, go elsewhere. The food here is decidedly unique, adventurously creative and utterly delicious. The menu is limited. Get over it, everything on the menu is fantastic. The portions appear small, but they are not, they are perfectly portioned for ultimate satisfaction without gluttony. It's not cheap. So what, it's worth it. 120%. Ruben and his staff are absolutely top notch, drinks are as unique and tasty as the food and the ambiance is casual chic. We. Love. This. Place. Check it out. I recommend the cauliflower appetizer and whatever their fish special is. Their risotto is the bomb as well. Thanks Ruben and TBS team!

My coworker took me for my first time today and I was very impressed! I ordered the Buffalo Chicken Sandwich and it was delicious. The friendly staff even suggested some add ons and I am SO glad I listened to them. They know what they're talking about! There was a long line when I walked in but it moved very quickly due to the speedy service.

So so good! Delicious food, lots of veggie options. The server accommodated us well for a large group, which we really appreciated. If you like spicy, you must get the cumin style tofu (they had meat option too). Dan dan noodles were delicious (duh). Will have to go there again to try their other things.

This restaurant was seriously amazing. We came for brunch and the owner was our server. He had so much knowledge when it came to the wine selection and the food was AMAZING. There is absolutely not a bad thing I can say about this restaurant. *Chefs kiss*

Ordered several meals for take out just before Thanksgiving, Austin the bartender served us drinks and took our order. Great service and the food was excellent. You spend a little more , but worth it.

I've updated my review to 1 star from 3 due to the condescending, unapologetic email I received in response to our experience and now will most certainly never go back. The meal we had tasted good and came out quickly. Outside of that, the service was terrible, one of our desserts was stale, and they don't use buttercream frosting on their "buttercream frosting" cakes. According to the ridiculous email I was sent, it's a "Swiss Meringue Buttercream" which translates IMHO "no flavor". I made reservations for my birthday and they seated us outside in the 85 degree heat with 90% humidity instead of comfortably inside the air conditioning where there were plenty of open tables. We had to ask for silverware more than once just to be able to eat the meal that came out. We had to ask for a box 3 separate times before it was brought out, and more water at least twice. The food was good - we had the croque monsieur, lemon Parmesan chicken and pomme frites. They were out of the majority of their desserts and cakes I wanted to try, which is ridiculous on a weekend evening. And the ones we did try were way overpriced for what was served. The confetti cake was awful. I'm not sure where they learned to make buttercream frosting, but it had the flavor and texture of whipped topping icing and the cake was dry...as if it were a few days old. My husband had a cookie bar that also tasted like it was stale or a few days old. For $100 (without alcohol), I'd rather just eat someplace else in the f

Four Sons is pure magic. Aside from having some of the best thin-crust pizza in the city, they are really involved in the community and give back!

So let's stick to the food: fresh and delicious, every time. I've had their pizza and salads, and friends have had the hoagies. All of their ingredients are great quality. The salads are fresh, loaded with toppings, and come with some yummy garlic bread. The Italian hoagie my husband ordered was HUGE and loaded with meats and cheeses - exactly what you want in an Italian hoagie.

Last, but not least: the pizza. They have a gorgeously large rotating pizza oven, with pies made fresh to order (as well as having slices). The crust is magically thin and chewy, without being too crispy or soggy. They have decent sauce, and use excellent mozz to top. 

And let's talk service... after a Grubhub ordering snaffu where the delivery driver couldn't find our address (??) and then just disappeared.... Four Sons remade our order rush, we went in to pick it up, and they even gave me a slice on the house for our trouble.

Well I started my day off headed to My Favorite Muffin but when I got there there was a line to the door which is good for them :-). But it looked like it might be awhile so I decided to go down the road to Truckee bagel which didn't have a line to the door but had a few people waiting at tables. So I was patient and waited my turn after probably 15 minutes later other people were getting their smoothies and sandwiches that came in after me and all I ordered was two toasted Bagels with butter and cream cheese. When I inquired about the progress of my order the guy working behind the counter snap back at me saying they are doing things in order but I located my two Bagels just sitting on top of the toaster while they worked on sandwiches and other orders which came in after my order. the only reason I mentioned anything is because I didn't know how long they were going to sit there and it appeared to me they spaced them out. Yes they were very busy I was being patient waiting my turn but but when I inquired they were very rude back. The gentleman making the order was so mad he couldn't get the order Straight had to do another bagel which he did a half-assed job at because he was annoyed. And of course it didn't come out correct because I asked for it Double Toasted, it wasn't but I wasn't going to correct them again because he was already pissed off  pretty much  shoved my order to the counter and went on his way  and again was so mad he would forgot to give me the cream chees

This is really a good restaurant for italian dishes. The food is really good but I felt it is not that filling.May be I should try another dish here.  I am likely to go back again because I liked the location and the service.

Coming from ny u don't get food que unless it's mighty Quinn's bbq. Sooooo dang good I wanted back twice while on vaca. First time I went alone. Wings r crazy and so is pulled pork. I went end of June so check my reviews at Jackies_food_jaunts on Instagram

Met a friend in the parking lot for car by car dining. Ordered food for pick up. Employee who answered was very courteous and helpful. Ordered the pork sandwich with fries. Was ready for pick up in about 20 minutes. Nicely packed in a bag with the condiments. Sandwich was so incredibly good! Nice ratio of pork to toppings and the fries were crisp and had nice flavor. One of the best meals I've had in a long time! Can't wait to be go back when I'm in the area. Easy to eat in the car too! Great job!
When I saw this place I don't imagine what kind of food they have it is wonderful plenty of flavor this place is amazing very kind people, clean I'm back one or thousands times again!!!

I ordered from this place on grubhub, delivery took very long but the restaurant did have one driver at the time. The kani salad was my favorite, it was a good size portion. I would definitely order that again.

After landing at PHL and checking into our hotel ~ we hit the streets to find lunch and and an afternoon cocktail.  This was exactly the kind of place we were searching for. A bar that served deliciousness. We sat at one of two window seats ~ watching the entertainment of the city folks passing by. Our server was a feisty and equally friendly young gal. She shared enough about herself to get a lively conversation going, making us feel comfortable enough to not only eat but sit and laugh for awhile. We ate their take on a Jalapeño ranch Philly cheesesteak. It was fabulous. The bread itself was warm, light, with the flaky crust ~ probably anything that you put in it would be mouthwatering fabulousness. This sandwich was #1. I had my usual Moscow Mules... which were made perfectly.  I left full enough that I only had a salad for dinner.

We visited Applebee's in Pennsville NJ and were really disappointed again.   The meat was hot, the fries were cold, the red wine was cold instead of a room temp.  The grilled vegetables were warm but not cleaned properly, the peppers still had the seeds.  We asked for extra napkins because one of us had ribs but no napkins ever came.   So, I went to their website to give a review and that didn't work either.   

The question is...where do you eat in Pennsville????   Better yet, next time we'll eat in Delaware before our meeting in NJ.

I like this place and have gone multiple times in a different location at Chattanooga. I was in town and tried the Franklin location. The staff looked like they did not want to be there and was not very friendly. The smoothie was not blended well and it tasted okay but definitely could be better.

While the staff was friendly and helpful, our experience wasn't great due to two major points. 

1. BUGS! We found these little black bugs on our bed and on the floor. We looked it up and they were not bed bugs but looked more like baby beetles.

2. COVID protocols! We just got back from a weekend trip and were expecting the hotel to be following the safety measures listed on their website. We rarely saw team members wiping down slot machines or high touch areas. There were hand sanitizer stations available through out the casino/hotel but we were expecting to see them wipe down much more often. It was so crowded that they opened up all seats at their tables when they were supposed to keep some seats closed for social distancing. They even turned on some slot machines which were supposed to be off for social distancing as well. We expected them to limit capacity and have more strict measures in place such as limiting the number of guests in elevators, etc.

Overall, after taking the chance of visiting so soon after opening, we were really disappointed with this experience.

Not just a good Italian restaurant and not just a sweet neighborhood restaurant - Luciano's is both.  

Close and warm and home, this is what you'll get here.  Oh, and great food too.  Last night we had the penne puttanesca and spaghetti with meat balls.  Perfect and delicious.  

Starter was their crispy calamari with a delicious dipping sauce and freshly toasted bread.  A Shirley temple for the niece and we were settled in for a perfect meal out.

Live music and a steady hum of friendly conversation.  I have to push the penne puttensca it was extra tasty and super sized.  Thanks to the staff for taking care of us.

Extensive research went into where we should have breakfast in Santa Barbara. This was one the top rated & so we made our drive up early one Sunday & popped into downtown for some brekkie. Being Sunday, it was quiet & there wasn't much traffic. Many streets were closed to through traffic to allow social distancing of pedestrian traffic.  Parking was found around the corner & upon arriving, there was naturally a line. It wasn't too long of a wait. Orders are placed at the counter & a number is given to you. You are free to find your own table. There is both indoor & outdoor seating & indoor was ok when we went in October, but I'd check to see what the current situation is. We sat outside, along the side of the building & it's all very pretty. The building has big windows that pretty much open up to the outdoors & views are lovely. Now onto our food!! I had a plate of French toast. Hubby had the breakfast burrito. Yes & yes to both. All the flavors & textures were there. Moistness (I know y'all hate that word but it's important with certain foods) was on point cause I've had many a dry French toast & this wasn't dry. No rubbery burrito here. Prices are about standard for cute boutique-y cafes of this sort. They also have these tempting looking pastries behind the glass at the counter. Try NOT to take one with you! 99.9% chance that scone will be going home with you. It probably won't make it that far.

one of our favorite Thai restaurants in Tampa/Brandon area. We either order out or dine in here once a week. My favorite dish there is the Pineapple Fried Rice,  and my wife usually orders some kind of curry, either the red or green. Honestly,  I have never tried anything else other than the Pineapple fried rice because it's so good, I usually get it Hot, which is the perfect level of heat. My wife always loves her curries,  have never had a complaint about their food. Service can be a little slow sometimes,  but i can't blame them for that, especially when there are so many take out orders and dine ins, that usually is a good sign of a good restaurant. If u like great Thai good, go check this place out!

Still the best breakfast in Clearwater! Since there's no outside dining they are now running all tables we'll probably switch to take out since it's such a popular breakfast spot! The cheese sticks in the danish basket are to die for!

Not sure what all the ranting & raving is about this place. Had a co-worker mention it, so it was our first time, but I don't think my husband & I will be back. I ordered the roast beef w/ fries; He ordered the southern fried steak. My fries were room temp, and hard because of it. The roast beef was decent, but nothing amazing. Husband said the same about his- it was okay but nothing great. Said he could it make it at the house. Again- not terrible but during dinner we both had wished we had chosen somewhere else. I will say they do have lots to choose from on the menu, which is nice, but I truly wonder how much of it is homemade/made in house and not pre-packaged and frozen. Beyond the food, we were told a 20 minute wait and waited 40. Didn't realize the served a basket of bread until our waitress asked us if we wanted it now or with our food. I feel as if this should automatically be brought out, otherwise whats the point of a bread basket? I don't want bread with my main meal. After seeing it on anothers table, I could care less. Its sliced white bread with prepackaged butter. What the? Why even? A tad irrelevant but I do feel atmosphere matters, and the music selection was so awful. Eminem, bebe rexha, and halsey. I imagine the staff makes the playlist, if I had to guess. Not sure how the persistent & higher percentage of the older crowd we saw there stands it. The outdoor seating is nice I will say but we didn't choose it because husband was getting bit up as we were wai
went for lunch with friend.  i enjoyed it...we weren't in rush, so it was nice.  enjoyed my seafood platter. friend had seafood linguine which looked really yummy.  i would go back.

We stopped for a nice meal and were treated to wonderful service, delicious food, and amazing wait staff. Even the manager, Brandon, was all hands on deck. He was serving food, clearing tables, moving furniture, and ensuring guest satisfaction. Our waiter, Justin, was spot on. He was diligent in watching our table, had refills on our drinks before we would ask, catered to us, and made us feel at home. The food was absolutely delicious. We were in during the lunch rush, and we're still had great service that was quick and accurate. We were able to hear the kitchen staff communicate with the expo and the wait staff, they were fabulous. We will definitely be back. 
Thank you, Grill Smith, for a terrific lunch. 
Ivan and Mary Cuesta
The food was pretty good but a bit overpriced for pizza and chopped cheese. The parking for this establishment is horrible.

Delicious dinner last night at Antica BYOB. Every did was amazing. For appetizers we shared the meatballs w ricotta, the polenta w Gorgonzola, artichokes, sautéed onions & the grilled octopus w arugula . Entrees we had were the Pork Cheeks w Portobello mushrooms w grilled polenta, short rib spinach fettuccini, chicken w crab w tomatoes & spinach, gnocchi w Gorgonzola cream sauce ( very rich) I have had the Gnocchi in pesto sauce,  Tagliatelle alla Bosciala w fava beans, different mushrooms, pancetta. You can't go wrong w any entree. Everything was awesome. For dessert we shared the pistachio chocolate bread pudding w ice cream & a tiramisu. Complementary house made limoncello after the meal is terrific.  BYOB w no corkage fee!!!! We love everything about Antica.

When I want sushi, I order delivery from here. Staff was always nice, in person, and food is good. Now, delivery comes pretty quick, and I'm always happy with my order. Give it a try, next time you want sushi.

This a Tampa staple for a reason! Not only is everything delicious but all of the staff were so friendly and helpful. We went on a weekday morning knowing that it can get pretty packed. This location doesn't have any tables but we just ate al fresco on the curb ha. Also their cafe con leche is no joke, it kept me caffeinated for hours!!! Obviously don't leave without their Cuban bread, no matter if it's plain, toasted with butter, of fully loaded as a breakfast sandwich it's freaking delicious!
Incredible food and might have been the best Bloody Mary I've had. Awesome patio too.  They make all their own dressings and sauces, even the ketchup, which was awesome. Can't recommend it enough.

I am giving 4 starts because their beer is some of the best in the city. Food wise only had the crispy brussel sprouts and they were average at best and I try sprouts everywhere that has them. Slightly warm and shredded to leaves w few intact pieces of sprout. Atmosphere is so so. Interior is so simple and drab may have been designed by owner's dog.  Where is the imagination?

Alright, so I've never had a Philly overnight until now, been looking forward to one, and this place totally topped all expectations! I didn't even mean to end up here. I was actually in the shuttle from the hotel to try a place the driver recommended the night before, and I was in full uniform when the driver randomly informed me that the place I was dying to try a cheesesteak from was actually a bar. Not a great look, a pilot walking into a bar in uniform. Fortunately, while we were discussing this issue I spotted a gem I'd heard about but couldn't find on google maps for whatever reason, and asked to stay there and give their Philly a try. 

HOLY CRAP!! This place is now one of my all
Time favorites from all my travels!! It was early, so the lady setting up outside wasn't quite ready, but when I preferred they went to work and got my Philly done FAST. That said, I'd wondered if I'd tipped enough (definitely not now that I've tasted the food), and thought it would be a bust. I walked back to my hotel, and tasted this cheesesteak, and it's like it got better with every single bite! It was quite literally one of the tastiest things I've ever had! Get the Big Philly with the hot peppers, large, and I promise you'll go back every time no matter where you are in philly. I can't wait to go back just to tip them more for their breathtaking food.
